dataset.attribution: PolyAI, MInDS-14; recordings and provided native-language transcriptions. Daniela Gerz, Pei-Hao Su, Razvan Kusztos, Avishek Mondal, Michal Lis, Eshan Singhal, Nikola Mrksic, Tsung-Hsien Wen, Ivan Vulic.
dataset.citation: Multilingual and Cross-Lingual Intent Detection from Spoken Data (2021), https://arxiv.org/abs/2104.08524
dataset.changes: Original mono8kHz WAV recordings (source codec retained per row) converted to Opus48k mono; row0 also to stereo AAC44.1k. Metadata removed; no time trimming or content edits.
dataset.selection: First five rows (0 through4), selected before any recognition result; no performance-based selection.

normalization: Lowercase Unicode letters/digits; punctuation ignored; ё=е; no number rewrite or stemming

decision: Do not promote Base Q5_1 as the product default on this evidence: aggregate improvement is four word edits, one recording worsened, semantic mistakes remain and measured translated-emulator inference time increased about1.83x. Keep quality acceptance open and assess a lighter Russian offline alternative separately.
limits: Only five preselected narrowband banking recordings, not representative all-chat acceptance.
ARM64 translation on an API30 x86 emulator, not physical-phone or owner-PC speed.
Source/reference annotation issues and recognizer mistakes cannot be separated solely by aggregate WER.
Later source-language UI update0278c533 is separate from the measured release JNI and was not exercised.
